articles.title: Air India, Tata Digital losses push Tata Sons’ new ventures towards Rs 29,000 crore hit: Report
articles.summary: New businesses under Tata Sons are projected to face significant combined losses, reaching up to Rs 29,000 crore by FY26. This figure drastically exceeds the earlier estimate of Rs 5,700 crore. For SSB aspirants, this highlights the financial challenges faced by major Indian conglomerates, reflecting broader national economic trends and the complexities of large-scale business ventures.

articles.title: Trump repeats threat to Iran’s infrastructure, dismisses war crime concerns
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump stated he is unconcerned about committing potential war crimes, threatening to destroy Iranian bridges and power plants if Tehran fails to meet his Tuesday deadline. This escalates tensions between the nations, highlighting the potential for severe military action and international law violations amidst ongoing diplomatic friction.

articles.title: MSMEs seek force majeure relief amid Gulf war disruptions
articles.summary: Small companies with government and Public Sector Undertaking contracts have urged the Centre to invoke 'force majeure'. They cite significant disruptions in raw material supplies, impacting their ability to fulfill contractual obligations. This appeal seeks protection from penalties due to unforeseen circumstances, aiming to safeguard businesses and ensure the continuity of essential projects amidst prevailing supply chain challenges.
